_meta.description: 矿业新闻本地样本库。用于离线开发与无网络环境下保证 MCP 工具可验证。
_meta.source_policy: 本文件为合成样本数据，非实时抓取结果。所有 URL 指向真实可访问的媒体主页，仅作引用示例。

articles.title: Pilbara lithium expansion: Greenbushes JV confirms additional drilling budget
articles.summary: The Pilbara Greenbushes joint venture has approved a supplementary drilling budget to extend the resource base. The programme targets deeper pegmatite intercepts beyond the current mine plan, with first assays expected within the quarter.

articles.title: Australia releases updated critical minerals list, lithium added to strategic reserve category
articles.summary: The federal government has revised the Critical Minerals Strategy, elevating lithium into the strategic reserve category and outlining additional exploration incentives for Western Australian projects.

articles.title: Pilbara port expansion clears environmental review, lithium export capacity to double
articles.summary: Environmental authorities have cleared the Pilbara port expansion, allowing lithium concentrate export capacity to be doubled. Construction is scheduled to begin in the following quarter.

articles.title: Nickel supply tightens as Indonesian quota policy reshapes export volumes
articles.summary: Indonesian quota adjustments are expected to reduce global nickel supply. Analysts expect LME nickel inventories to draw down through the quarter, with price volatility increasing on quota announcements.

articles.title: Copper treatment charges hit multi-year low, smelter margins squeezed
articles.summary: Spot copper treatment charges have fallen to their lowest level in four years as concentrate supply remains tight relative to smelting capacity. Producers have responded by deferring several expansion projects.

articles.title: Lithium spot price consolidates on balanced supply-demand outlook
articles.summary: Lithium carbonate spot prices held within a narrow range through the quarter. Market participants cite balanced inventories and continued project ramp-up as the primary drivers.

articles.title: Pilbara exploration results confirm high-grade lithium intercepts
articles.summary: Reverse circulation drilling returned high-grade lithium intercepts across multiple pegmatite zones. The company will update its resource model once assay verification completes.

articles.title: EU battery regulation drives procurement shift toward traceable lithium
articles.summary: New EU battery regulations take effect, requiring documented provenance for battery-grade lithium. Producers without verifiable supply chains face restricted access to European offtakers.

articles.title: Iron ore outlook: steel mill demand softens into fourth quarter
articles.summary: Steel mill utilisation has declined ahead of the seasonal slowdown. Iron ore spot prices responded with mild weakness, though port inventories remain below seasonal averages.

articles.title: Zinc concentrate treatment charges collapse on smelter overcapacity
articles.summary: Zinc concentrate treatment charges have fallen to levels below many producers' cash cost base. Several high-cost operations have announced curtailments in response.
